programme.title: Poisson davril
programme.desc: Carly et Spencer évoquent les événements du passé, alors qu'ils sont sur le point d'être renvoyés le jour du Poisson d'avril.

programme.title: Pear Store
programme.desc: Freddie obtient un emploi dans un magasin Pear, mais Sam obtient le même poste.

programme.title: Demilloween
programme.desc: iCarly célèbre Demilloween, un nouvel événement inventé par Carly quand elle annonce la tenue d'une fête!

programme.title: Chip la terreur
programme.desc: Spencer se bat contre le frère de Chuck, Chip.

programme.title: Banni
programme.desc: Les intrusions intempestives de Ti-bo dans l'appartement de Spencer et de Carly agacent cette dernière au point qu'elle lui en interdit l'accès. Le voilà banni des lieux ! Pour se venger, il en fait de même avec Carly et la bannit du Smoothie Groovy.

programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Le vol
programme.desc: Sam a perdu son ordinateur portable. Carly et Freddie tentent de l'aider à le chercher. Spencer retrouve des tickets du Funk E. Fester's et décide de remporter le plus gros lot, Murray, le dauphin magique.

programme.title: Au revoir -- Première Partie
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Au revoir
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Que le spectacle commence
programme.desc: Carly est accusée pour une des sottises de Sam. Madame Briggs leur fait alors organiser les essais pour les nouveaux talents. Avec l'aide de Freddie, ils filment les auditions.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Alien invasion
programme.desc: Une machine à tuer venue d'un autre monde arrive sur Terre pour tuer des humains.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: La nuit des morts-vivants
programme.desc: Barbra et Johnny rendent visite à la tombe de leur père dans un cimetière isolé lorsqu'ils sont soudain attaqués par des zombies. Barbra parvient à s'échapper et se réfugie dans ce qui semble être une ferme abandonnée. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Ben, qui s'est arrêté à la maison car il avait besoin d'essence. Assiégés par les morts-vivants, Ben fait de son mieux pour sécuriser les portes et les fenêtres. Les informations à la télévision sont inquiétantes : des créatures reviennent à la vie partout. Barbra et Ben sont surpris de découvrir cinq personnes cachées au sous-sol : Harry, Helen et Karen Cooper, ainsi qu'un jeune couple, Tom et Judy. Les dissensions apparaissent presque immédiatement, Harry Cooper voulant prendre le commandement. À mesure que la situation se dégrade, leurs chances de survivre à la nuit diminuent minute après minute.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: Un Noël de roman
programme.desc: La romancière cynique Dru Cassadine, connue pour ses romans d'amour, cherche désespérément à percer après une série d'échecs. Poussée par des critiques acerbes et la menace de son éditeur de la licencier, elle n'a que quelques semaines pour écrire un best-seller.

programme.title: Le secret de maman
programme.desc: Après avoir vu un homme en costume de Père Noël embrasser sa mère, un garçon pense que le vrai Père Noël veut remplacer son père, alors il part en guerre de farce contre lui.

programme.title: Les aventures d'Elf Man
programme.desc: Le Père Noël envoie un de ses elfes pour aider deux frères à arrêter des voleurs qui prévoient d'entrer dans leur maison. Ils découvrent qu'Elf-Man est un vrai super-héros. Ensemble, ils devront arrêter les voleurs pour avoir le Noël dont ils ont rêvé.

programme.title: Un refuge pour mon bébé
programme.desc: Dans une violente tempête de neige, cinq jours avant Noël, deux jeunes se rencontrent par hasard : Lisa, 23 ans, enceinte et effrayée, et Brad, snowboardeur professionnel.

programme.title: Double Destinée
programme.desc: Eve, une organisatrice de fêtes qui doit choisir entre un événement de dernière minute et des vacances romantiques. Tandis qu'elle réfléchit à ces deux perspectives, laquelle choisira-t-elle?

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: Un tueur professionnel, hanté par des visions de son sanglant passé, perd le contrôle. Son travail est compromis lorsqu'il atteint un point de non retour, et qu'il se retrouve forcé de défendre sa famille contre ses propres employeurs…

programme.title: Hansan
programme.desc: En 1592, Yi Sun-shin, amiral en chef de l'armada coréenne et héros national, doit affronter l'envahisseur japonais et ses formidables navires de guerre. La situation est désespérée pour le royaume de Joseon et le seul espoir de renverser le cours de la guerre réside dans l'arme secrète de l'Amiral, le Bateau-Tortue à tête de dragon...

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1990, deux grands noms du rap sont assassinés : 2Pac et Notorious B.I.G. Histoire de gangs, compétition musicale ? L'inspecteur Russell Poole, aidé du journaliste Jack Jackson, va tenter de tirer au clair cette affaire.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un mystérieux vagabond se fait piéger et accepte un travail de concierge dans un parc d'attractions condamné appelé Willy's Wonderland. Il découvre bien vite qu'il est en fait un sacrifice humain pour d'étranges créatures. Le parc se transforme en effet en cauchemar vivant peuplé d'animatroniques possédés par des démons...

programme.title: Qui j'ose aimer
programme.desc: Au bord de la mer, sous un soleil éclatant, Primo et Jeanne jouent au tennis, mais Jeanne n'a pas la tête au jeu. Dans un petit appartement sous les toits parisiens, Jeanne et Jules font l'amour… A Paris ou sur la Côte d'Azur, une mouette est le témoin silencieux des errances amoureuses de cette jeune femme, de ses doutes, de sa solitude…

programme.title: Suicide Express
programme.desc: Valentin aime les comédies musicales d'antan, Adélaïde non. Valentin aime la vie, Adélaïde un peu moins. Quoi qu'il en soit, il n'a peur de rien pour la convaincre, pas même du ridicule.

programme.title: On ne badine pas avec Rosette
programme.desc: Alice reprend du jour au lendemain le rôle de Rosette dans On ne badine pas avec l'amour. Lors de sa première représentation, elle se retrouve mêlée à un jeu un peu particulier entre les acteurs.

programme.title: L'hiver est proche
programme.desc: Louise, la trentaine, travaille comme agent des espaces verts, dans une forêt qui borde la ville. Son travail : faire de la médiation, empêcher les jeunes de faire du scooter dans les bois, et les familles, des barbecues. Un Camp de Roms chassé d'une ville voisine s'est s'installé dans cette forêt.

programme.title: Chahut
programme.desc: A Dunkerque, pendant le carnaval, un carnavaleux se retrouve seul dans les rues désertes. Il erre un moment avant d'arriver sur la plage où il découvre que les bruits du carnaval proviennent de la mer. Il décide alors de s'enfoncer dans l'eau et disparaît.

programme.title: Marche forcée
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'une classe verte dans les Cévennes, Lucas, professeur de français dans un lycée de banlieue, surprend deux de ses élèves, Samia et Djome, à l'écart en train de fumer de l'herbe mais bientôt le trio se perd dans le paysage de rivières et de forêts sauvages...

Après un séisme, un homme se réveille emprisonné dans les décombres. Lorsque tout espoir semble perdu, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul, une autre personne est prisonnière. Ensemble, ils vont tenter de survivre à cette situation désespérée.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Mémo
programme.desc: Louis, retraité, veut à tout prix garder son indépendance face à la surprotection de sa fille Nina.

programme.title: J'aime beaucoup ta mère
programme.desc: Stéphane, quarante ans, une ancienne petite terreur du collège rend visite à sa mère. Celle-ci doit lui présenter son nouveau compagnon : Martin Mollard, sa tête de turc du collège….

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: Mon amoureux
programme.desc: Romain, c'est mon amoureux. On s'embrasse avec la langue. On va se marier, on va vivre ensemble et on va avoir des enfants. On va même avoir des rapports sexuels. Mais bon, aux Eglantines, c'est interdit. Alors samedi, ma petite soeur, elle vient nous chercher en voiture pour nous emmener à la campagne.

programme.title: Vertige
programme.desc: Dans notre monde urbain, le système jette les hommes à terre dans l'indifférence. Mais vue sous un angle nouveau, la ville devient un espace à redécouvrir et à reconstruire.

programme.title: Yulia
programme.desc: Subitement arrachée à ses journaux, Yulia, se retrouve parachutée dans une pièce sans issue avec cinq manettes fixées au mur. En les actionnant, elle déclenche une série d'événements absurdes qui la conduiront à trouver l'âme soeur.

programme.title: Moonkup
programme.desc: Comme toutes les femmes d'Europe, Eva donne son sang pour faire durer la paix avec les vampires. Elle est la fille bâtarde du puissant Monsieur Pire qui a fait fortune dans le transport de l'hémoglobine. Quand Monsieur Pire décide de marier sa fille légitime au fils d'un puissant vampire, Éva profite de la noce pour rendre justice aux femmes, quitte à mettre en danger la paix.

programme.title: La vie sauvage
programme.desc: Arnaud et Nora, trentenaires en vacances, terminent leur weekend en province par une visite d'un parc safari. Tout excités à l'idée de découvrir une faune insolite, ils se comportent comme des enfants et se prennent pour des animaux, oubliant un instant que ces derniers sont en liberté… Entre sexe, folie et barbapapa, le couple ne sortira pas indemne de cette expédition.

programme.title: La Pureté de l'enfance
programme.desc: L'écoute d'une cassette retrouvée transporte la bédéiste Zviane vers son enfance. Basé sur un enregistrement réel, ce film hilarant traduit avec un style ludique l'imaginaire des enfants. Une fenêtre sur le quotidien signée Chroniques du 9e art.

programme.title: Nice
programme.desc: Martial, 17 ans, a fugué à Nice pour venir voir sa mère, chanteuse à la vie chaotique. Près de la maison de celle-ci, il rencontre trois femmes : une employée des Assédic, une ancienne camarade de classe et la propriétaire des lieux. Trois fragments d'éducation sentimentale, trois secrets, trois chansons.

programme.title: Java Heat
programme.desc: L'histoire se concentre sur les conséquences d'un attentat-suicide en Indonésie, où un Américain imprudent se faisant passer pour un étudiant diplômé cherche à se venger.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO
programme.desc: À propos des premières années de Yang Luchan, maître de Tai-chi. L'homme qui a fondé le Tai-chi au XIXe siècle et ce qui est aujourd'hui devenu le style de Tai-chi le plus populaire au monde. Le deuxième volet de la trilogie "Tai Chi" poursuit le parcours de Yang Luchan, un enfant prodige qui a aidé à sauver un village des soldats.

programme.title: Tokyo Tribe
programme.desc: Dans un Tokyo futuriste, la ville est divisée en quartiers, dirigés par des gangs distincts. Mera, le chef de l'un d'eux, souhaite régler une affaire personnelle avec un membre d'une faction rivale, entraînant ainsi une guerre totale.

programme.title: Trumbo
programme.desc: En 1947, Dalton Trumbo était le meilleur scénariste d'Hollywood, jusqu'à ce que lui-même et d'autres artistes soient emprisonnés et mis sur liste noire pour leurs convictions politiques.

programme.title: Poisson D'avril
programme.desc: Emile, un mécanicien apprécié mais un brin naïf, se laisse convaincre par un vendeur insistant et lui achète un attirail de pêche. Préférant cacher cette dépense déraisonnable à sa femme, Emile s'éclipse pour tester le matériel chez une cousine, Annette. Une série de quiproquos improbables les obligent à prétendre que tous deux forment un couple.

programme.title: La Bete A L'affut
programme.desc: Morane, un détenu en cavale, se réfugie chez la jeune et jolie Liliane Vermont, à qui il fait croire en son innocence. Prise dans le jeu, Lililiane veut fuir avec Morane mais s'aperçoit que ce dernier est en fait un assassin très dangereux. La jeune femme tentera malgré tout, par amour de la sauver.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Qui a tué Maggie Moore(s)?
programme.desc: Le chef de police Sanders enquête sur les meurtres étranges de deux femmes portant le même nom et démêle un réseau de mensonges dans une petite ville.

programme.title: The Promotion
programme.desc: Deux gérants adjoints d'un supermarché s'affrontent pour décrocher un poste convoité.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Red Joan relate l'histoire de Joan Stanley, accusée d'espionnage pour le KGB et d'avoir livré des secrets de fabrication de l'arme nucléaire à l'URSS.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Dave et son équipe ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur show...

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Une famille quitte la ville animée de Chicago en faveur d'une nouvelle vie dans une ferme de tournesols isolée. Mais leur nouveau départ vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'une série d'étranges événements les poussent à croire qu'ils ne sont pas seuls dans leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: The Gate
programme.desc: Un arbre est enlevé du jardin de Glen et révèle un mystérieux trou qui mène à un portail et la chambre souterraine d'un mal terrifiant.

programme.title: Soul Survivors
programme.desc: Après avoir failli mourir dans un accident de voiture dans lequel son petit ami y est resté, une étudiante reprend le cours de sa vie, mais semble se trouver dans une espèce d'état secondaire. Perdue entre le monde des vivants et celui des esprits, les fantômes de l'au-delà cherchent à l'emporter, pire encore, à utiliser son corps possédé pour pénétrer dans notre monde.

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Une famille quitte la ville animée de Chicago en faveur d'une nouvelle vie dans une ferme de tournesols isolée. Mais leur nouveau départ vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'une série d'étranges événements les poussent à croire qu'ils ne sont pas seuls dans leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: Forces of Nature
programme.desc: Ben doit atteindre Savannah pour son mariage. Mais une mouette percute le moteur de son avion lors du décollage, et tous les autres vols sont annulés à cause d'un ouragan en approche. Il décide donc d'y aller en voiture avec la belle Sara.

programme.title: Lamborghini : lhomme derrière la légende
programme.desc: Dans l'Italie de l'après 2ème Guerre Mondiale, une course de légende oppose deux rivaux : Enzo Ferrari (Gabriel Byrne) et Ferrucio Lamborghini (Frank Grillo). Lamborghini, de ses modestes débuts consacrés à la fabrication de tracteurs à sa quête de la voiture parfaite, est devenu grâce à son génie une icône de l'industrie automobile. Mais ses passions n'ont pas été sans conséquences sur sa vie personnelle, remplie de romance comme de tragédie.

programme.title: Ransom Games
programme.desc: Deux agents du FBI à la recherche de trafiquants découvrent un étrange objet d'origine japonaise aux pouvoirs immenses. Ils vont devoir tout faire pour empêcher cet objet destructeur de tomber entre les mains d'un riche businessman.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: Coup de Foudre à Oxford
programme.desc: Caro Drake, émotionnellement gardée, arrive à Oxford avec le seul objectif d'obtenir son doctorat, mais à travers une amitié turbulente avec un charmant jeune homme, Caro commence à s'ouvrir au mystère des nouvelles expériences, à la vulnérabilité et à l'amour.

programme.title: Le baiser du serpent
programme.desc: En Angleterre, au XVIIe siècle, un architecte de jardin hollandais (Ewan McGregor, « Moulin Rouge ! ») est entraîné dans un réseau de passion et de trahison après avoir été engagé par un riche marchand.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Nick Marshall est LE macho à l'américaine! La clope au bec, toujours bien rasé, les abdos hyper dessinés, ce qu'il faut de poils, un regard à tomber par terre, et bien sûr le sourire éclatant laissant entrevoir ses dents d'une blancheur étincelante.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: La brigade des mœurs est toujours à la recherche du mutilateur qui s'attaque aux prostituées du quartier rouge de Gand. Leurs soupçons se portent sur Tim, un client régulier attardé qui vient d'agresser Hannah. Alors qu'il est en cellule, une troisième victime est signalée : elle porte les mêmes traces de mutilation que les autres, mais son assaillant lui a également tranché la carotide. Entretemps, en se rendant chez son père, la commissaire découvre que la porte a été forcée, et la maison saccagée…

programme.title: Love Hacks
programme.desc: Sam, coach en relations amoureuses, est convaincue qu'elle peut réparer n'importe quelle histoire d'amour et crée un podcast pour le prouver. Mais Josh, son producteur plein d'humour, la met au défi de tester ses propres sentiments.

programme.title: The Love Gala
programme.desc: Lorsque Kate se voit confier l'organisation du Gala du Jardin de sa mère, le plus grand événement festif de l'année, elle doit trouver un compromis avec le nouveau directeur, au caractère opposé, du jardin botanique.

programme.title: Stolen from the Suburbs
programme.desc: est une mère célibataire qui mène une vie tranquille en banlieue avec sa fille adolescente de 16 ans, Emma. Un soir, après avoir quitté discrètement la maison pour un rendez-vous, Emma est enlevée et intégrée de force dans un réseau criminel de traite d'êtres humains.

programme.title: Blind Trust
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Au Cœur des Sentiments
programme.desc: Deux sœurs se retrouvent dans la maison familiale et retrouvent espoir après la mort de leur père.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Chien Milliardaire
programme.desc: Un enfant affronte des voleurs maladroits pour sauver un chien portant un butin de diamants.

programme.title: The Outcasts
programme.desc: Deux amis surmontent une humiliation causée par les filles cools au lycée.

programme.title: Le Noël du coeur
programme.desc: Baxter Billings devient le Père Noël secret de sa ville après avoir gagné une fortune. En aidant anonymement les habitants, il se rapproche de Pamela et de son fils… mais ses sentiments compliquent ses fiançailles déjà prévues.

programme.title: Flirt et passe-passe
programme.desc: Lors d'un séjour à Trinité-et-Tobago, deux jumelles identiques sont prises l'une pour l'autre par leurs prétendants respectifs. En jouant le jeu, elles découvrent que l'amour pourrait les mener là où elles ne l'attendaient pas.

programme.title: L'amour dans l'oreillette
programme.desc: Sam, coach en amour réputée à Los Angeles, guide ses clients pendant leurs rendez-vous. Mais lorsque Mattie remet en cause ses méthodes, Sam découvre que le véritable amour ne suit peut-être aucune règle.

programme.title: Ce qu'on fait par amour
programme.desc: Sophie, médiatrice ambitieuse, rejoint une prestigieuse firme de bien-être à Manhattan. Obligée de collaborer avec Jason, séduisant coach de vie et fils du patron, elle découvre que leurs opposés s'attirent.

programme.title: Coup de foudre et conséquences
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie romantique, Matthew Perry (Chandler de la série télé 'Friends') est Alex Whitman, un New-yorkais envoyé à Las Vegas pour superviser un projet de construction. Il y rencontre Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek, Desperado), et une attraction certaine les réunit le temps d'une nuit. Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.title: Où sont passés les Morgan?
programme.desc: Un couple séparé de New York est le témoin d'un meurtre et est placé sous protection des témoins dans un village du Wyoming.

programme.title: Think Like A Man
programme.desc: Quatre femmes ont lu le livre Act Like a Lady, Think Like a Man, écrit par le célèbre humoriste-animateur radio Steve Harvey, et inspiré par sa rubrique 'Strawberry Letters' de son émission radio The Steve Harvey Morning Show. Steve Harvey remarquent que ces femmes sont capables de diriger une petite entreprise, de s'occuper à merveille d'une famille de trois jeunes enfants et ou encore de diriger un groupe communautaire en même temps, mais sont incapables de découvrir ce qui plaît aux hommes. Pour lui, elles ne doivent par chercher conseil auprès d'autres femmes : seul un homme peut leur dire comment séduire un homme et le garder. Cependant, tout ça n'est pas du goût de l'autre moitié des 4 couples...

programme.title: Mon beauf, ma sœur et moi
programme.desc: Patrick a toujours eu une relation agressive avec sa petite sœur Marilyn. Mais quand elle ramène à la maison son fiancé star de la télé, Ryan, la guerre est déclarée dans ce film désopilant et cauchemardesque sur une famille qui s'aime à en tuer.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un entrepreneur militaire reconnu revient sur le site de ses plus grands triomphes de carrière et renoue avec un amour de son passé, tout en craquant de manière inattendue pour une dure à cuire de l'Air Force qui lui est assignée.

programme.title: Status Update
programme.desc: Kyle Moore, un ado perturbé par la séparation de ses parents, et qui peine à trouver ses marques dans sa nouvelle maison, découvre une application magique qui transforme ses status sur les réseaux sociaux en realité.

programme.title: Big movie
programme.desc: La parodie ultime des plus grands blockbusters, de X-Men à Pirates des Caraïbes en passant par le Monde de Narnia et Harry Potter.

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Deux chasseurs de primes noirs, à la poursuite d'un hors-la-loi, prennent le contrôle d'une petite ville de l'Ouest sans shérif.

programme.title: La révolte des indiens apaches
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un conflit violent éclate entre des magnats des chemins de fer avides et une tribu d'Apaches, seuls deux hommes peuvent empêcher la guerre : Winnetou et Old Shatterhand.

programme.title: Ben et Charlie
programme.desc: Deux bandits sympathiques tentent de gagner leur vie dans le Far West.

programme.title: Quatre salopards pour Garringo
programme.desc: Une bande de malfaiteurs braque un convoi transportant de l'or destiné au Trésor public. Cette nuit-là, Farley vole l'or, mais on le retrouve mort le lendemain matin.

programme.title: Compilation Bonanza Épisodes 23, 24, 25
programme.desc: Les aventures de Ben Cartwright et de ses fils dans le Far West, alors qu'ils gèrent et défendent leur ranch du Nevada tout en aidant la communauté environnante.

programme.title: Le Vent de la Justice
programme.desc: Dans le monde sans foi ni loi du Far West, Dead Men suit le parcours d'un jeune homme contraint d'entreprendre un voyage pour venger la mort de son père, protéger la tribu apache qu'il a appris à aimer et reprendre les terres et l'or qui leur reviennent de droit.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Furieux de la façon dont une belle jeune fille sourde-muette est traitée par son père, un berger vivant dans une cabane de montagne isolée, Little Joe prend sur lui d'enseigner à la jeune fille le langage des signes afin qu'ils puissent mieux communiquer. Son plan se retourne contre lui lorsque la jeune femme tombe amoureuse de lui et que le voisin brutal de la jeune fille lui en veut de prodiguer son attention au plus jeune des Cartwright.

programme.title: Jacob, l'homme qui a lutté avec Dieu
programme.desc: Dans ce drame classique, Jacob est obligé de fuir pour sauver sa vie lorsqu'un Ésaü enragé jure de le tuer.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again

Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists

Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right

programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

Seeking the truth, Gwanghae visits the royal artisan Mun Saseung to confirm whether the piece was made at the Bunwon—just as Jeongi steps inside.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.15

Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.16
programme.desc: As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.17
programme.desc: Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

programme.title: The Return of the Osprey

Wendy and Denis have set launched an ambitious challenge of reintroducing the Osprey to Switzerland, a century after its disappearance.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Hidden UK

Indisputably stunning landscapes, providing homes for noble stags, soaring eagles, playful dolphins and endlessly entertaining otters. And this is just the tip of the iceberg – countless discoveries are waiting to be unearthed if you decide step off the beaten track in search of the hidden UK.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem
programme.desc: Monkeys: loveable, aggressive, diverse and full of mischief. Our distant cousins have much in common with us. They're intelligent, cooperative and have complex relationships. They're some of the most evolutionary successful species on the planet, successful across the globe from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons. Swinging through our family tree quickly reveals the diversity of our monkey relatives. They come in all shapes and sizes, and are certainly not as different from us as we might think.

programme.title: Tropical (Kingdom's of the Sun)
programme.desc: The tropics can be found in the band around the centre of the Earth. This position shapes dramatic landscapes and a range of challenges to all who live there. Tropics are perhaps best known for rainforests thanks to the extensive rains and lush, fruiting vegetation, these exhibit the greatest biodiversity of any habitat on the planet. The tropics aren't just about rainforests, however. They also support remarkable grasslands and even deserts, where yet more incredible flora and fauna can be found.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E03
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The sun is going to be beating down, they're going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they're all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We've got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan's Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We've got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They're going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other's strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let's find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world's strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we'll find out.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history's most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman's patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. “There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill,” the undertaker remembers. “It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn't quite fit.” Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.10 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA

programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.
